sources.cite: Kubernetes documentation, Debug Services: 'Does the Service have any EndpointSlices?'
sources.note: Read in primary text from kubernetes/website main branch at commit 1bee6f03 (raw Markdown source of kubernetes.io) on 2026-11-14 (the kubernetes.io page itself did not answer the fetch). Relevant text: 'Inside the Kubernetes system is a control loop which evaluates the selector of every Service and saves the results into one or more EndpointSlice objects'; 'If the ENDPOINTS column is <none>, you should check that the spec.selector field of your Service actually selects for metadata.labels values on your Pods. A common mistake is to have a typo or other error'.

Read in primary text from kubernetes/website main branch at commit 1bee6f03 (raw Markdown source of kubernetes.io) on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: 'The controller for that Service continuously scans for Pods that match its selector, and then makes any necessary updates to the set of EndpointSlices for the Service.'

Read in primary text from kubernetes/website main branch at commit 1bee6f03 (raw Markdown source of kubernetes.io) on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: HPA and VPA 'use data from the metrics API'; 'You can also view the resource metrics using the kubectl top command'; 'The Metrics API, and the metrics pipeline that it enables, only offers the minimum CPU and memory metrics to enable automatic scaling'.

sources.cite: Argo CD documentation, Automated Sync Policy (argoproj/argo-cd master, docs/user-guide/auto_sync.md)
sources.note: Read in primary text from the repository source on 2026-11-14. Relevant text: with 'selfHeal: true' Argo CD syncs 'when the live cluster's state deviates from the state defined in Git'; 'The automatic sync interval is determined by the timeout.reconciliation value in the argocd-cm ConfigMap, which defaults to 120s with added jitter of 60s for a maximum period of 3 minutes.' How soon self-heal reverts a live edit is not stated as a number there; the scenario's 3 minutes is the author's.
